annotations.title: Model-based estimates, company guidance and track record

description: Return FinancialMD's own forward estimates for a company: the next four quarters and two fiscal years of revenue, operating income, net income, diluted EPS and free cash flow, each a point with an 80 percent interval, computed from the company's SEC filings by the published method fmd-baseline-1 (the median of four seasonal components, moved to the company's own guidance midpoint where it gave one). These are NOT consensus and NOT analyst or Street estimates: always call them "FinancialMD model-based baseline estimates", never "the estimate" or "expected by the market". Every estimate carries generated_by: model, the proof ids of the facts it read, its components, and track_record: the error of the same method replayed over history using only facts known at each date (median_ape, wape against naive_wape, bias, interval_coverage), for this company and for all companies; quote the track record whenever you quote an estimate. data.guidance is what the company itself stated (range, basis GAAP or adjusted, the exact sentence, accession and character offsets). data.signals are rule-based descriptions: guidance raised, lowered or maintained against the prior statement, the direction of our own estimate revisions, and the reported result against the guided range and against our prior estimate. There are no ratings, no price targets and no advice here. as_of answers as known at that date. Use it for forward-looking questions, guidance, and whether a result came in above or below what the company guided.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

metric.description: Only estimates of this line (guidance is always returned in full).

period_type.description: Only quarterly or only fiscal-year estimates.

name: company_estimates

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { generated_by: "model", label, method, estimates: [{ metric, period_type, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, value, interval, components, anchor, revision, input_fact_proofs, track_record }], guidance: [{ metric, low, mid, high, basis, source, change, result }], signals: [{ kind, direction, rule }], track_record, coverage_note, disclaimer }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Model-based estimates, company guidance and track record
